A logic synthesis engine elaborates Verilog/VHDL, applies Boolean optimization (ABC-style), maps to a standard-cell library, and optimizes for timing, area, and leakage. description: Compiles RTL into optimized gate-level netlists for area, speed, and power.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Logic Synthesis and Optimization Engine, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (RTL elaboration with full SystemVerilog support). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: RTL elaboration with full SystemVerilog support and Technology-independent Boolean optimization. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Static timing analysis tool) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
capabilities: RTL elaboration with full SystemVerilog support
